data.narrative:
Exolaunch is a bootstrapped Space & Aerospace company founded by space-tech engineers from TU Berlin. The valuation universe comprises 13 peers across the sector: 5 public companies (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private entities including SpaceX, Sierra Space, Planet Labs, Impulse Space, and Apex Space.

Two standard triangulation methods prove inapplicable here. Peer-Median anchoring fails due to insufficient same-stage and adjacent-stage comparables within Space & Aerospace—while 11 same-sector peers exist, fewer than three meet narrow filtering criteria, making an all-sector median unreliable. Public-Comp Anchoring cannot be deployed because Exolaunch's revenue is not on file. The Space & Aerospace public median trades at 23.9x P/S across the 6-ticker set, but without disclosed revenue, this multiple cannot be applied to the target.

No triangulated valuation range can be supported with the available data. A credible analysis would require either: (i) Exolaunch's historical or forward revenue; (ii) a sufficiently dense peer set at matching stage and scale within Space & Aerospace; or (iii) disclosure of recent transaction or funding activity. Without these inputs, any point estimate or range would rest on assumption rather than method. Further data collection is necessary before proceeding to valuation.
